mapper.select: SELECT a.id,COALESCE(p.nickname,'未设置昵称') AS nickname,COALESCE(p.bio,'') AS bio FROM user_accounts a LEFT JOIN community_public_profiles p ON p.owner_id=a.id WHERE a.id=#{ownerId}
SELECT owner_id,nickname,bio,version FROM community_public_profiles WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_public_profiles(owner_id,nickname,bio,version) VALUES (#{ownerId},#{nickname},#{bio},1) ON CONFLICT (owner_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE community_public_profiles SET nickname=#{nickname},bio=#{bio},version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND version=#{version}
